title: Mobile Deposits and Wire Transfers on Hunter Green
summary: Covers Hunter Green mobile check deposits (up to $10,000/day), including check endorsement, image capture in well-lit conditions, and retaining the physical check until it appears in account history. Also details domestic wire transfer fees ($15 outgoing; 5 free incoming per month, then standard fees), plus out-of-network ATM fee rebates up to $20/month with receipt submission if requested.
